brief.fact: Maternity Africa is a Christian-based not-for-profit that provides fistula treatment and maternity care for marginalized women in Tanzania.
brief.source_title: Maternity Africa | Making Childbirth safe.
brief.excerpt: Maternity Africa is a Christian-based not-for-profit organization that endeavours to provide fistula treatment and quality maternity care for all marginalized women throughout Tanzania.

brief.fact: Maternity Africa operates from its base at Kivulini Maternity Centre, outside the city of Arusha.
brief.source_title: Maternity Africa | Making Childbirth safe.
brief.excerpt: Maternity Africa currently operates from its base at Kivulini Maternity Centre outside the city of Arusha in Northern Tanzania.

brief.fact: Maternity Africa says Kivulini Maternity Centre strengthens the skills of national health care workers through training and mentoring of its service-delivery staff.
brief.source_title: Who We Are | Maternity Africa
brief.excerpt: Maternity Africa’s base at Kivulini Maternity Centre strives towards being a ‘centre of excellence’ that also strengthens the knowledge, skills, experience, competence and confidence of national health care workers. It does this through training and mentoring of staff engaged in service delivery.

brief.fact: Kivulini Maternity Centre has its own laboratory, theatre, pharmacy, wards of up to 56 beds, administrative offices and staff accommodations.
brief.source_title: Kivulini Maternity Centre – News | Maternity Africa
brief.excerpt: The Centre is equipped with its own laboratory, theatre, pharmacy, wards accommodating up to 56 beds, administrative offices and staff accommodations.

brief.fact: In November 2025 Maternity Africa broke ground on a second facility, the Phaedra Maternity Health Centre in Chamwino, Dodoma.

brief.excerpt: Maternity Africa reached an exciting milestone with the groundbreaking of the Phaedra Maternity Health Centre in Chamwino, Manchali, Dodoma; a facility that will soon expand access to quality maternal care and fistula treatment for women in the region.

hook.sentence: Your website says Kivulini Maternity Centre trains and mentors the staff engaged in service delivery, so such a benefit would fit that commitment to developing your team.
